headline: Mississippi River Bluffs and Civil War Heritage
reservation: Vicksburg National Military Park requires an entry fee or a valid federal lands pass. While the park tour road is self-guided, some historic home tours in the downtown district require timed tickets during the spring pilgrimage season; check official house websites for current availability.

days.title: Military History and Ironclads
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the Visitor Center

stops.name: Vicksburg National Military Park
stops.detail: Drive the 16-mile tour road to see over 1,300 monuments and the historic battlefield landscape.

stops.name: U.S.S. Cairo Museum
stops.detail: View the remains of a salvaged Union ironclad gunboat and its recovered artifacts.

days.driving: Allow 2–3 hours for the park loop; conditions vary.
days.note: Check the NPS website for potential road closures on the North Loop.

days.title: River Views and Historic Architecture

stops.name: Old Court House Museum
stops.detail: Visit this 1858 landmark sitting on the city's highest hill for a look at local antebellum history.

stops.name: Biedenharn Coca-Cola Museum
stops.detail: See where the beverage was first bottled in 1894 within a restored candy store.

days.note: Steep hills in the historic district may be challenging for walking; use local transfers.

days.title: The Mighty Mississippi

stops.name: Jesse Brent Lower Mississippi River Museum
stops.detail: Engage with interactive exhibits regarding river flood control and climb aboard a decommissioned towboat.

stops.name: Vicksburg City Front Murals
stops.detail: Walk along the floodwall to view 32 murals depicting the town's history through the centuries.

days.driving: Minimal; concentrated in the riverfront area.
days.note: Riverfront areas can be subject to seasonal flooding; check local conditions.

intel.title: Park Gate Hours
intel.text: The National Military Park has strict gate closing times that change seasonally. Ensure your vehicle is out of the tour loop before the posted exit hour.

intel.title: Downtown Hills
intel.text: Parking near the Old Court House can be limited on narrow, steep streets. Utilize the flatter lots near the riverfront for larger vehicles.

intel.title: Urban Coverage
intel.text: Signal is excellent throughout Vicksburg and the National Park. Use digital guides provided by the NPS for an enhanced tour experience.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Vicksburg is a major service hub on I-20. Fuel and supplies are abundant before heading into the rural Mississippi Delta to the north.

intel.title: Historic Home Entry
intel.text: Many historic homes are private residences or bed and breakfasts. Only enter those with official tour signage during designated public hours.

plan.arrival: Fly into Jackson (JAN) and drive west; check into a historic B&B or riverfront hotel before heading to the Military Park.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are fine; be aware that some historic district streets are very steep and narrow.
plan.goldenHour: The 101st Ohio Infantry Monument offers sweeping views of the river valley during the sunset hour.
